full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for disposal of the Rule are that the petitioner as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 10 of 1990 in the Court of learned Assistant Judge, Chowddagram, Comilla for declaration of title in the Schedule 1 land to the plaint measuring an area of 63 decimals appertaining to plot No. 526, Khatian No. 128 of maize Chakla Roshonabad and also for khas possession in the 2nd schedule premises of the plaint after eviction of the defendant there from contending, inter alia, that the suit property belonged to plaintiffs predecessor Azim Miah who died leaving& behind 4(four) sons named Musa, Aslam Amir and Ana Mia. By an amicable partition amongst those 4(four) brothers the suit land was fallen in the saham of Amir Ali. Amir Ali died leaving behind the plaintiff and pro-forma defendant Nos. 10-13 as heirs. Thereafter, by another amicable partition the suit land was allotted to the saham of the plaintiff. While he was in possession in the Schedule-1 land to the plaint he was dispossessed from a part of schedule-1 land that is from the schedule-2 land to the plaint by the middle of 1989 AD. The defendants erected two huts upon the schedule-2 land to the plaint covering an area of 0.0189 acre. It is the further case of the plaintiff that the recent khatian was wrongly recorded in the name of defendants for an area of 0.57 acre and 6 acre was recorded in the name of the predecessor of the plaintiff in khatian No. 86. Taking advantage of that wrong recording of Khatian the defendants had dispossessed him. The plaintiff came to know about the wrong record on 14-12-1989 and, as such, the suit.
